[Intro]
[C#]

[Verse 1]
[C#]Home alone on Fri-
[G#]day night No
[Fm]better time for ex-
[F#]ercise And
[G#]wishing you were still
my girlfriend
[C#]Sweeping floors and fold-
[G#]ing napkins
[Fm]Praying something cool
[F#]might happen The
[G#]sun explodes, we die
[F#]The world ends
[C#]Talking to my friends
[G#]about stuff
[Fm]Nasty beer and plast-
[F#]ic handcuffs
[G#]Back when them and
you and me Would
[F#]share our space in
[F#m]harmony

[Chorus]
[C#]Oh,
why did I do that?
Why does
everything collapse?
Even when
it's glued together
[C#]Hey,
[G#]why did I do that?
[F#]I make
[A#m]everything collapse
[D#m][Fm]Even when
[A#m]it's glued together

[Solo]
[C#]
[A#m]
[G#]
[C#]

[Verse 2]
[C#]Questioning my awk-
ward footing
Mixing bitter pills
with chocolate pud-
ding Hiding gift-
ed fixtures
[C#]Trying not to say
[G#]words out loud
[Fm]Wondering if I'm talk-
[F#]ing too loud
[G#]My eyes burning holes
in
[F#]your old
[F#m]pictures

[Chorus]
[C#]Oh,
[C#/G]why did I do that?
[F#]Why does
[A#m]everything collapse?
[D#m][Fm]Even when
[A#m]it's glued together
[C#]Hey,
[G#]why did I do that?
[F#]I make
[A#m]everything collapse
[D#m][Fm]Even when
[A#m]it's glued together

[Outro]
[C#]Fuck you
[C#/G]why did I do that?
[F#]It's your fault
[A#m]I can't relax
[G#]But nothing's chang-
ing while I'm
[F#]sitting here With both
hands glued toge-
ther
